Instructions

1

Hold the dumbbell close to your chest.

2

Bend hips and knees; keep heels grounded.

3

Let knees follow the direction of toes.

4

Keep your chest lifted and feet planted.

5

Push through your whole feet to rise.

6

Finish standing without leaning back.

Watch out

Letting the weight tip you forward. Hold the bell tight to your chest, keep elbows inside your knees at the bottom, and stay tall through mid-foot.
